summary: Tested the frontend for the IT/EN i18n change and Home redesign, using Playwright against the public URL at 320/375/390 px. Real sender<->viewer calls were run with separate browser contexts set to different languages. PASS: (1) First launch: after clearing storage, the app goes to /language. The phone language is pre-selected (en-US -> English, it-IT -> Italiano), and the screen previews the selected language as you pick. Continue -> /welcome (3 steps + terms) -> Home. (2) English mode: welcome steps, terms, /legal?doc=terms and /legal?doc=privacy, and Home are all English. Viewer: 'Headset', 'Waiting for a call.', stage iframe lang=en 'Waiting for video…'. Sender: 'Starting camera…' -> 'Camera ready. Enter the headset code.', with a fake camera. Pro (prices €6.99 / month and €59.99 / year, activate/deactivate confirm), history, gallery and contacts (validation errors, saved notice, 'Sure?' delete) are English too. A scan for Italian words found nothing in English mode, including aria-labels. (3) home-language-button -> /language?from=home -> Italiano + Salva goes back to Home, which shows Italian right away. Switching back to English works. A deep-link /language?from=home also saves and returns to Home. (4) The language persists after reload. (5) Italian regression: home, welcome, terms, pro, history, contacts, gallery, viewer and sender are all Italian, with no English words. (6) Home at 320 and 390 px, IT and EN: no mid-word breaks (Range-rect check), no horizontal overflow, cards stacked (column, icon+chevron on top), greeting small and grey, slogan in a single language. (7) /api/join is English for an en-US browser and Italian for it-IT. (8) Cross-language call (viewer EN, sender IT): quick-reply chips are in each person's own language. Viewer sent 'I can see you well' -> the sender saw 'Ti vedo bene' (in chat and toast). Sender sent 'Non ti sento' -> the viewer saw 'I can't hear you'. Decline and answer statuses are correct in each language, and the report sheet and block confirm are English. FAILED/ISSUES: deep links skip the language and terms gate (HIGH). Minor: singular/plural text, untranslated native-only strings, join og/title meta always Italian, radio a11y state.

minor.issue: <title> and og:title/og:description are hard-coded Italian ('IriDuo · codice …', 'a tu per tu, in 3D. Tocca per aprire…'). WhatsApp/SMS link previews are therefore always Italian, even when an English user shares their code. Only the body text is switched by navigator.language. Reference: /app/backend/join.html:7-9

ui_bugs.issue: Only Home (app/index.tsx:68-73) redirects to /language and /welcome. A fresh install opened through an invite deep link (/sender?code=XXXXXX, which /api/join opens) goes straight to the sender screen and auto-places the call. The user never chooses a language and never accepts the terms/age rules. Reproduced with a fresh browser context: localStorage had no lang_v1 or terms_v1, and the sender status already showed 'Code not found…' from the auto-call. The same happens with /viewer, /contacts and the other screens.

No singular form: 'IriDuo history' showed '1 calls · 00:00 in 3D'. The Italian equivalent shows '1 chiamate'. The same applies to 'You have 1 free calls left' / 'Ti restano 1 chiamate gratuite' and '1 more calls hidden'. Reference: app/history.tsx:134,147; app/pro.tsx:43

The options use accessibilityRole='radio' with accessibilityState={{selected}}. Radios need {checked}: on web, aria-checked is missing, so screen readers do not announce which language is chosen. Reference: app/language.tsx:48-49

issues: No maxWidth: on tablet/desktop widths the options and the button stretch edge-to-edge (seen at 1568px). This is cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: The camera, microphone and motion usage descriptions are Italian only, so English users see Italian system permission prompts. Use app.json 'locales' (expo-localization plugin) for per-language InfoPlist/strings. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json:59-67
The Sharing dialogTitle 'Salva o condividi' is hard-coded Italian (src/media.ts:24). The StageView iframe title 'Scena VR180' is an Italian a11y label (src/components/StageView.web.tsx:46).

action_items: HIGH: Gate every entry route on first launch. In _layout.tsx (or a shared hook), after loadLang(): if !langChosen() -> /language, else if !terms_v1 -> /welcome. Keep the deep-link target (e.g. /sender?code=…) and continue to it after the user accepts. This stops an invite link from skipping language choice and terms, and from auto-calling.
Localize the join.html <title>/og:title/og:description. Options: Accept-Language on the server, or a &lang= param added by ShareCode joinLink().
Add singular/plural forms for the 'N calls', 'N free calls left' and 'N more calls hidden' strings in IT and EN.
Add app.json 'locales' with English and Italian permission strings.
Translate the media.ts Sharing dialogTitle and the StageView iframe title.
language.tsx: use accessibilityState={{ checked: on }} for the radio options.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n via tr(it,en) + useSyncExternalStore is simple and works. Module-level lists are correctly wrapped as functions (BITRATES(), REASONS(), RULES(), FEATURES()), so nothing is frozen at import time.
CallChat localizeQuick maps quick replies by index between QUICK_IT and QUICK_EN. The two arrays must stay the same length and order. Free text is passed through unchanged (correct).

Sender status classification regexes (sender.tsx:303,386) match both languages. EN 'declined', 'no answer' and 'not found' map to the same CallResult as IT, which was verified in history ('Declined' / 'Rifiutata').
viewer.tsx (715 lines) and sender.tsx (710 lines) exceed the 700-line guideline and should be split.
Contacts hint says 'The headset code changes every time it opens'. This contradicts the viewer's 'Always keep this code' option, so the copy is outdated in both languages.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows pass; 1 HIGH gate-bypass issue on deep links plus minor copy/a11y items)

seed_data_creation: No seed data was created. A TEST_Mark contact (123456) was created and deleted, in a browser-local store only. Calls were made between throwaway browser contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storage values are JSON strings. To preset state, use add_init_script: localStorage lang_v1=JSON.stringify('en'|'it'), terms_v1='true', onboarded='true'. For cross-language calls, use page.context.browser.new_context(permissions=['camera','microphone'], locale=...). The browser already has fake media. Read viewer-code by polling. Chat chips: viewer-chat-composer-quick-N and sender-chat-composer-quick-N; messages: *-chat-msg-them. If the sender leaves with page.goto, that call is not saved in the sender's history; use the hang-up button for history checks.
